We are an engineering company engaged in the design, manufacture and supply of hydraulic fittings catering to diverse industrial applications, with over four decades of operational experience in the hydraulics industry. Our product portfolio comprises standard hydraulic fittings viz. DIN-metric fittings, JIC flared and flareless fittings, O-Ring Face Seal (ORFS) fittings and conversion fittings, as well as fittings customized to customer specifications. As of March 31, 2026, our portfolio consists of more than 11,000 stock keeping units (SKUs) of hydraulic fittings, serving diverse application needs across industries such as construction machinery, automotive, farming machinery, injection moulding machines and hydraulic systems. In addition, we have obtained certifications which enable us to cater to sectors such as railways and defence, thereby expanding our addressable market. We operate on a business-to-business (B2B) model across both domestic and international markets. Our sales approach combines direct engagement with original equipment manufacturers (“OEMs”) and other industrial customers as also through a network of authorized distributors and distribution partners. Direct customer engagement enables us to build long-term relationships and offer tailored solutions aligned with specific industry requirements. During Fiscal 2026, we have supplied to 170 direct customers including OEMs. To complement our direct sales efforts, we leverage a network of distributors and distribution partners in India and overseas, which allows us to expand our reach to a broader customer base. The distributors typically maintain inventory in their territories, promote our products, provide after-sales support, and act as the primary interface for customers. This dual-channel distribution strategy enhances our market penetration and provides us with the opportunity to increase market share for our offerings across a wide range of industrial sectors. We have also engaged with a non-exclusive distribution partner in Europe who is not directly involved in customer acquisition but primarily provide post-sale services, local coordination and logistics support. As on March 31, 2026, our international presence extends to markets such as USA, Belgium, Poland, Russia, Brazil, Italy, Saudi Arabia, Hungary, UAE, Thailand and Germany supported by relationships with global customers including OEMs, industrial customers and distributors. The hydraulic fittings market in India is experiencing significant growth, driven by the expansion of various industries such as manufacturing, construction, automotive, and agriculture. As infrastructure development and industrialization continue to rise, there is an increasing demand for hydraulic systems, which in turn boosts the need for high-quality hydraulic fittings. Key trends in this market include the growing adoption of automation, increasing investments in renewable energy projects, and a shift towards more durable, corrosion-resistant, and efficient hydraulic components. Furthermore, the rise of local manufacturing and the availability of cost-effective solutions are making hydraulic fittings more accessible to small and medium-sized enterprises. Additionally, advancements in technology, such as the integration of IoT and smart sensors in hydraulic systems, are shaping the market's future. (Source: CARE Report) The increasing adoption of technologically advanced machines across various industries such as agriculture, construction, material handling, and aerospace is expected to drive growth in the hydraulic fittings market. In India, the hydraulic fittings market has grown at a CAGR of 10% between CY21 and CY25 and is projected to expand at a higher CAGR of 11% from CY26 to CY31. (Source: CARE Report) The hydraulic fittings market is experiencing dynamic growth globally, with significant trends emerging across various regions. In Asia, particularly in China and India, industrialization and infrastructure development are driving the demand for hydraulic systems, fuelling the need for hydraulic fittings. The region’s expanding manufacturing sectors, such as automotive and construction, are significant contributors to this growth. The hydraulic fittings market in Asia grew at a CAGR of 8.5% from CY21 to CY25 and is expected to grow at CAGR of 9.2% from CY26 to CY31. Meanwhile, the Middle East is witnessing increased demand due to large-scale oil and gas projects, where high-performance hydraulic systems are essential. The development of renewable energy sources in the region, such as solar and wind, is also contributing to the market expansion. The hydraulic fittings market in the Middle East grew at a CAGR of 9.2% from CY21 to CY25 and is expected to grow at CAGR of 10.1% from CY26 to CY31. In the USA, the hydraulic fittings market is driven by advancements in automation, aerospace, and agriculture. The country’s focus on manufacturing innovations and infrastructure upgrades supports the growing need for hydraulic components. The hydraulic fittings market in the USA grew at a CAGR of 7.5% from CY21 to CY25 and is expected to grow at CAGR of 8.2% from CY26 to CY31. Europe follows a similar pattern, with increased investments in industrial automation and green technologies like electric vehicles (EVs) and renewable energy contributing to market growth. The demand for hydraulic fittings in sectors such as construction, mining, and transportation is also prominent in this region. The hydraulic fittings market in Europe grew at a CAGR of 7.8% from CY21 to CY25 and is expected to grow at CAGR of 8.6% from CY26 to CY31. (Source: CARE Report) COMPETITIVE STRENGTHS Integrated operations and product development capabilities Our product portfolio includes more than 11,000 SKUs, comprising standard hydraulic fittings such as DIN-metric fittings, JIC flared fittings, O-Ring Face Seal (ORFS) fittings, and conversion fittings. We also have the capability to develop application-specific fittings tailored to customer specifications and applicable industry standards, with 880 new SKUs in Fiscal 2026, 1,676 in Fiscal 2025, and 2,206 in Fiscal 2024. This breadth and pace of product development demonstrates both the scale and adaptability of our operations. Our manufacturing operations encompass die-designing, forging, heat treatment, machining, plating and inspection and testing, which are primarily conducted in-house. …

blocks.t: Global Economic Growth Expected to Sustain at ~3% in Near Term Global economic growth is projected to moderate to around 3.1% in 2026, reflecting the impact of geopolitical tensions in energy and trade flows. The ongoing Middle East conflict poses downside risks, with prolonged disruptions potentially reducing growth further to 2.5%, or lower. However, supportive factors such as continued investment momentum and policy support are helping offset some of these pressures. Global economic growth faces headwinds from geopolitical tensions, volatile commodity prices, high interest rates, inflation, financial market volatility, climate change, and rising public debt. The IMF forecasts GDP growth for India at 6.5% in CY26, far outpacing the estimated CY26 global average of 3.1%. Key drivers include strong domestic demand, government capital expenditure and moderating inflation. Public investment is expected to exhibit healthy growth as the government has allocated a strong capital expenditure of about Rs 12.20 lakh crores for FY27. The private sector’s intent to invest is also showing improvement as per the data announced on new project investments and resilience shown by the import of capital goods. Additionally, improvement in rural demand owing to healthy sowing, improving reservoir levels, and progress in south-west monsoon along with government’s thrust on capex and other policy support will aid the investment cycle in gaining further traction. …

Compression fittings continue to account for the largest share of the Indian hydraulic fittings market owing to their superior sealing capability, high-pressure performance and ease of installation. These fittings establish leakproof joints by compressing ferrules or sealing rings around the tubing, making them highly suitable for hydraulic systems operating under demanding pressure and vibration conditions. The segment is widely used across construction machinery, mining equipment, agricultural machinery, machine tools and industrial hydraulic systems due to its reliability, ease of maintenance and compatibility with multiple tube materials. …

The Indian compression fittings market increased from USD 81.5 million in CY21 to USD 119.5 million in CY25, registering a CAGR of approximately 10.0%, and is projected to reach USD 216.8 million by CY31, growing at a CAGR of around 10.5% during CY26–CY31P. The segment is expected to maintain its leadership position throughout the forecast period, supported by increasing deployment of heavy hydraulic equipment and replacement demand from industrial applications. Common types of compression fittings include: o Flare fittings, capable of handling higher operating pressures and wider temperature ranges. o Standard compression fittings, utilizing ferrules or metal rings to create leak-proof seals. o Mechanical grip fittings, comprising two-ferrule assemblies that offer superior vibration resistance and can be repeatedly assembled without compromising sealing performance. …

Threaded fittings represent the second largest segment of the hydraulic fittings market owing to their versatility, cost-effectiveness and compatibility with a wide range of hydraulic equipment. These fittings employ internal (female) and external (male) threads conforming to internationally accepted standards such as BSP, NPT, JIC and Metric threads. Their widespread usage across industrial machinery, mobile equipment, process industries and OEM manufacturing continues to support steady demand. The threaded fittings market expanded from USD 59.9 million in CY21 to USD 87.2 million in CY25 and is projected to reach USD 158.7 million by CY31, reflecting healthy double-digit growth over the forecast period. Rising domestic manufacturing, equipment localisation and increasing industrial automation are expected to sustain demand for precision-machined threaded hydraulic connections. •

Crimp fittings are extensively used in hydraulic hose assemblies where permanent, high-strength hose-to-fitting connections are required. These fittings are manufactured by mechanically crimping a sleeve around the hose using specialized crimping equipment, resulting in highly secure and durable connections capable of withstanding elevated pressures and cyclic loading. The growing demand for heavy-duty hydraulic hoses in construction equipment, mining machinery, transportation, material handling and industrial manufacturing is expected to support robust growth in this segment. The Indian crimp fittings market increased from USD 43.4 million in CY21 to USD 61.6 million in CY25 and is projected to reach USD 107.1 million by CY31. Demand is increasingly shifting towards no-skive hose assemblies, which reduce installation time while maintaining high operational reliability. •

Flange fittings are primarily used in large-diameter, high-pressure hydraulic systems where conventional threaded connections become less practical. These fittings provide excellent resistance against pressure surges, shock loading and mechanical vibration, making them suitable for demanding applications such as steel plants, mining equipment, marine systems, heavy construction machinery and industrial hydraulic presses. The Indian flange fittings market grew from USD 30.5 million in CY21 to USD 46.1 million in CY25 and is expected to continue expanding over the forecast period to USD 88 million by CY31, driven by increasing investments in heavy engineering industries and large hydraulic installations. Demand for flange fittings is expected to remain concentrated in high-capacity industrial equipment requiring enhanced structural integrity and leak-free performance. …

End fittings provide the interface between hydraulic hoses and equipment, enabling secure and applicationspecific hydraulic connections. Depending on end-use requirements, these fittings are available in multiple configurations, including clamp-end, plain-end and custom-engineered designs. The market is increasingly shifting towards higher-performance end fittings offering improved corrosion resistance, enhanced fatigue life and simplified assembly processes, particularly for mobile hydraulic equipment and heavy machinery. The Indian end fittings market increased from USD 19.3 million in CY21 to USD 30.0 million in CY25 and is projected to reach USD 59.5 million by CY31. Growth is expected to be supported by rising demand for customised hydraulic hose assemblies across OEMs and replacement markets. •

The "Others" category comprises specialised hydraulic connection solutions designed for niche applications requiring unique pressure ratings, fluid compatibility or installation configurations. These products are increasingly finding applications in aerospace, defence, specialised industrial equipment and customised hydraulic systems. This segment is projected to grow steadily from USD 13.9 million in CY21 to USD 33.2 million by CY31, supported by increasing product customisation and the expanding application base of hydraulic systems. 1.6.2 Based on function Hydraulic fittings can also be segregated on the basis of the functions they perform. 1.
